history.physicalLevelsIntroduced: Very Easy was added as a finer learner rung and retained in physical artifacts.
history.publicRollup: The public surface later became Very Beginner, Beginner, Easy, Medium, Advanced; Very Easy remains a legacy physical ID and opt-in route.

evidence.finding: six-level calibration established physical order, scores, and read-only ladder diagnostics
public difficulty navigation rolled up to five levels while retaining six physical levels
upload completion copy follows the public Easy representative

contractQuestions.veOrderingAfterRollup: Generation and physical validation were intentionally left on the six-level order; the public rollup did not establish that VE->Easy remains a learner-facing requirement.
contractQuestions.legacyAccess: Existing legacy VE access depends on the physical ID and route remaining available, not on a new Easy artifact being larger than VE.

cover.detail: Easy has more notes but fewer attacks; the easier direction increases attack rate.

historicalVeToEasyEvidence.conclusion: VE->Easy was already redundant on two fixtures and non-monotonic on the Cover attack dimension before Lane A.

criteria: public learner progression and difficultyScore ordering
legacy Very Easy existence and individual validity

controls.A: harder can have fewer notes while being faster, wider, more polyphonic, or harder to coordinate; raw count is therefore a coarse guardrail
controls.B: many repeated trivial notes can increase count without increasing useful learner difficulty
controls.C: melody can be retained while redundant accompaniment is removed and harmonic/technical complexity increases
controls.D: different arrangement strategies can be non-nested even when their public learner role is ordered
controls.conclusion: raw total note count is useful for the existing physical nesting guard, but is not sufficient as the sole public difficulty definition

candidateA.policy: frozen Candidate A: one protected semantic local thinning pass; no retiming or new events

errors: very-easy has 2560 notes but easy has 2130 (easier should not have more)
